newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algerians number nearly 29 million, growth falls.
newsitem.headline: Algerians number nearly 29 million, growth falls.

text.p: Algeria's population totalled 28,856,000 on January 1 and was increasing at an annual rate of 1.89 percent, the official Algerian news agency APS reported on Thursday.
APS, quoting official figures in El Djoumhouria newspaper, said the growth rate had fallen from 2.53 percent in 1995 and 2.82 in 1994.
It said at a rate of 1.89 percent the population would reach 29.4 million on January 1, 1998.
